Build the required payload manifest

Six payload digests plus manifest.json.

Trust still needs an external provenance decision.

Defined teaching contract / analytic illustration.
2 minutes / practice. Teaching intent: Build the required payload manifest. A manifest listing its own hash would be circular, so the manifest hashes six payload files, not itself. It cannot authenticate a malicious sender who replaces both file and digest. Review generated source before executing it. Visual purpose: Six payload digests plus manifest.json. Trust still needs an external provenance decision.
